outcome.comment: What the user did with the dialog: 'open' | 'install' | 'show' | 'close'

ms-vscode-remote.remote-wslopenInWSL.comment: Tracks the use of the open command

iswslinstalled.comment: Whether WSL is installed on the OS

origin.comment: From where the command was trggered. Currently only 'other'

outcome.comment: What the user did with the notification: 'open' | 'hide' | 'show' | 'close'

ms-vscode-remote.remote-wslresolver.comment: Reports the use and outcome of a resolver

connectionmethod.comment: The connection method used to connect to the server: 'localhost', 'wslExeProxy' or 'wsl2VMAddress'

failurereason.comment: In a case of failure, the reason: 'servererror', 'serverclose', 'timeout', 'wslnotfound', 'osincompatible', 'wslupdaterequired', 'daemonclosed', 'daemonerror', 'undefined'

frombrowser.comment: Whether the resolver was triggered from the browser

hostingremotename.comment: If the resolver was caled from another remote, the remote name of the hosting remote.

wslversion.comment: The WSL version installed of the selected ditro
